verdict.rationale: Superset's 'Design' browser-pane feature lets a user select an on-screen element and send that visual context to an agent (superset-gh-1), which is adjacent to the story but does not document attaching an actual marked-up screenshot or external mockup file to a task. There is no evidence of image/file upload with annotations being ingested as a task spec. Missing for 10: explicit screenshot/mockup upload capability, markup/annotation tools, and confirmation the agent parses image content into implementation instructions.
